description: This file defines a React component for displaying and editing a list of notes, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes via API calls, and incorporates a note editor subcomponent.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Selects a note for editing and displays the editor.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, updates the state, and resets the editor if necessary.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves a new or existing note by calling the relevant API function, then updates the state.
